people.name: NOODLE COOK
talk: The inspector asked what is in them. I said other. He wrote it down. Now it is on the menu.
Still deciding? The noodles are not.

people.name: FISHMONGER
talk: Fresh today. Which today, I did not say.
You are the friend. The quiet one, Moth, said a friend might come asking.
Moth bought line and hooks off me last week. Said they were not for fish.
Then asked which pier the Registry boats skip. I sell fish. I said the harbor has a lot of piers.
Moth paid cash. Nobody pays cash. Cash is for people who do not want to be remembered.
Buy a fish or go stand in someone else's rain.

people.name: REPAIRS
talk: I fix anything with a screw in it.
Not the Registry. That one is working as intended.
Your deck? Nice. Do not let me see the inside, I will want it.

people.name: FIRMWARE VENDOR
talk: (The note on the counter says BACK IN 5 MIN. The tape has gone yellow.)
